en.title: Tenace BJJ Knee Brace – Compression Knee Pad with Side Stabilizers & Gel Pad for Grappling, Jiu Jitsu, MMA, Wrestling, Judo & Muay Thai (Black, X-Large)
bullets: SUPERIOR IMPACT PROTECTION Integrated shock-absorbing gel pad helps reduce impact during takedowns, scrambles and ground work while protecting the knee during intense training.
STABILITY & COMPRESSION Side stabilizers combined with compression help improve knee support, increase stability and reduce muscle fatigue during BJJ, Grappling and Wrestling.
SECURE NON-SLIP FIT Two adjustable straps keep the knee pad securely in place throughout rolling, sparring and explosive movements without slipping.
PREMIUM DURABILITY Made from high-quality breathable materials designed to withstand daily BJJ, Grappling, MMA and Wrestling training while maintaining comfort and performance.

MADE FOR COMBAT SPORTS Ideal for Brazilian Jiu Jitsu (BJJ), Grappling, MMA, Wrestling, Judo and Muay Thai. Designed for athletes looking for knee protection, compression and stability without restricting movement.
